steps.name: The Other Side Discovered in the Sanctuary

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: Is it time already? The air at the valley entrance has changed. That must be %s.

lines.speaker: 미르
lines.text: Lord Atkina, I've never delivered a message without knowing what it said before. This one makes me curious.

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: I am curious, too.

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: I have never been to Freios, but I know it as a continent where the breath of the gods still lingers.

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: An empire of great influence on such a continent, and an empress with the gift of prophecy. She must be an extraordinary person.

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: Mir, the decree you gave %s. The trace of power left upon it is proof... Perhaps...

lines.speaker: 미르
lines.text: You felt it too, Lord Atkina.

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: Prophecy is speaking through a god's mouth. So perhaps the empress's gift means...

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: She may be a being like us, or like 'them.'

lines.speaker: 미르
lines.text: Lord Atkina, that's...

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: Mir, you must have some idea yourself.
(Atkina stops speaking as %s appears in the distance. Mir nods in understanding.)

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: I've been waiting.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Lord Atkina, I'm not late, am I?

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: Don't worry. There is still time.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, Mir, you're here too.

lines.speaker: 미르
lines.text: Yes, Adventurer. I only just arrived. My task includes seeing you read the contents, so I stayed to watch.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You always work so hard, Mir.

lines.speaker: 미르
lines.text: Thank you for saying so. Oh, I think it's time. Please open the decree.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Let's see...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: "Dear messenger of the goddess. A wicked group has gathered in the sacred land of Eidos. They intend to interfere with the divine revelation."

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That group...

lines.speaker: 미르
lines.text: Oh! Has something happened in Eidos? Everything was fine recently. Could you read the rest first?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text:
"Please visit for the sake of your god.

Empress of the Silvaria Empire — Kaina Dawn Silvaria..."

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: For Lady Iris...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I thought I'd go there for Iris someday. But is simply going enough...?

lines.speaker: 미르
lines.text: Recently, I delivered Lady Gaia's message to the Order of Seres. A divine revelation would take place where the reverse side was to appear...

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: Then a divine revelation will descend upon this place called Eidos.

lines.speaker: 미르
lines.text: Oh, now that I think about it, there are only a few days left. The paladins in Eidos must know about it. They'll all be trying to receive it.

lines.speaker: 미르
lines.text: Paladins who receive a divine revelation become beings no one can rival.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: But how did you receive Her Majesty's decree?

lines.speaker: 미르
lines.text: I went to the Temple of Seres on a delivery, and a sister gave it to me.

lines.speaker: 미르
lines.text: She said Her Majesty ordered me to deliver it to you. Apparently she knew I'd be visiting the temple.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: A reverse side appearing, and beings trying to obstruct a divine revelation... What is happening?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I need to go to Eidos. Thank you, Lord Atkina. Mir.

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: ...I would like to hope it is nothing serious, but it surely will be. Please take care.

lines.speaker: 미르
lines.text: Be careful, Adventurer.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I will. I'll be back.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then, shall I head to the sacred land?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Come to think of it, I don't know the way. How do I get there? Oh, there's a postscript to the decree. Let's see...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Tell the person who wants to rampage to go ahead...? What does that mean?

lines.speaker: 누군가의 목소리
lines.text: [Adventurer...]

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: ...Minuet?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That's definitely Minuet's voice.
(Minuet's voice falls silent.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I can't leave this. I'll go and see her...

steps.name: Where Is Lady Gaia…?
steps.objective: Find [Dayna] in the "Guild Union City Esnil Center".

lines.text: (Minuet stands with a vacant expression. She looks much as usual, yet something feels different.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Minuet?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Minuet, what are you saying? I can't hear anything...

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: Please... hur... ry...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hurry?

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: Help... La... dy... Gai... a...

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: He... has... ap... peared...
(Minuet struggles to form words, trying to convey something, but still no sound comes out.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Minuet, what do you mean? No, I'll find Lady Gaia somehow, so...
(Minuet takes both of %s's hands, then stops moving as though all life has left her.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Minuet? Minuet?!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Her body is fading...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I feel what I felt when I first came to Adrica.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I'm dizzy... It's as though the Land of Illusions is swallowing my memories...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Following Iris...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: This place...

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Come to your senses, %s...
(Medea comes into %s's view and taps %s on the shoulder with her staff.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Lady Medea? Oh, that's right! Minuet! Minuet...

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Calm yourself. You may fall into confusion again.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: All right...

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Adrica, which you saved, has fallen into this state again... It is my fault for not paying closer attention.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: %s, I will remain here, so do not worry too much. Go where you need to go.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Lady Medea...

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: I know what you wish to say. But...

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: In this matter, I will help the god. That will also mean helping you, who serves the god.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: It is my answer to the trust you have shown me...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I have so many questions, but with things as they are, they can wait...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, I understand. Then please take care of Minuet.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Of course...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (The reverse side appearing in the sacred land... I'll speak to Dayna first. She must know something.)
(Once Medea confirms that %s's presence has left Adrica, she lays Minuet down.)

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Goddess...

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Why did you make me the only one able to sense this...?

steps.name: Boundary of the Other Side
steps.objective: Check what happened to [Dayna], then find [Sera] in the "Guild Inn".

lines.text: (Dayna seems lost in thought with her eyes closed. Suddenly sensing something, she thrusts her staff forward.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Aaah! Dayna! It's me, %s!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Could you put that staff away? You nearly stabbed me.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Oh, sorry. I thought you were someone else.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Someone else?
(Dayna lowers her staff and smiles faintly, but the smile disappears as her legs suddenly give way.)

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Ugh...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Dayna, are you all right?

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Thank you for catching me. I'll be fine after some rest. I hope it lasts a little longer this time...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Are you ill?

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: This happens sometimes. It's more inconvenient than painful. After using too much power, my legs sometimes give out.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: I'm fortunate to have this staff Shiina made me. Without it, I couldn't even stand properly.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: I have to stay alive. Then I can scold my older sister and keep cherishing Shiina.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Why do I keep saying things I don't need to whenever you visit, %s?
(Dayna's expression is complicated.)

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Sorry. I've gone on too long.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm sorry, too. I hope I didn't interrupt your rest.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: I'm fine. I think I know why you came, %s. You need to go to the sacred land, don't you?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I heard a reverse side was discovered in Eidos.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: That's right. Raclette and Jelic were looking into it, but they had to stop. The person in charge there really hates people like us.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: They must be furious at the thought of impious people entering a sacred place of divine revelation. Paladins and monks really do judge us however they please.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Anyway, that's probably why my sister called for you, %s. Or perhaps another being led you...

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: I've spoken to the paladins at the tavern. Sera will tell you how to get to Eidos.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you, Dayna.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: And... So...
(Dayna is saying something, but not a sound can be heard.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Dayna? What did you say?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (She's speaking, but I can't hear a thing...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ugh, what's this?!
(A black shadow rises like a great wave behind %s, seizes %s, and swallows the adventurer whole.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ugh... ugh...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ugh...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Uuuugh...
Your Highness. It has been a long time. Your greetings remain as violent as ever.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That's...
(Dayna and the owner of the unfamiliar voice slowly appear in a corner of the darkness.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Where am I...?

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: You... You're... Surely...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Dayna? And who's that? But I was just standing in front of her... Can she not see me?)
(With murderous intent, Dayna swings her staff at the being she calls a demon.)
Do you care if this barrier hiding me from the others breaks? If not...

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: State your business.
(Dayna lowers her staff and stares at the demon.)
Hehe. To think a barrier woven by a mere human could be this strong...

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: I don't want praise from a demon. Speak...
What happened then was regrettable. But it had to be done.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: The demon who used my sister as a sacrifice and left me like this...

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Barbatos, Grand Duke of Despair...
(Dayna seethes at only now recalling the demon's name.)

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: Oh, you remember. I am honored to hear you speak my name, Your Highness. I was involved, yes, but only in a small part. At the heart of it was, of course, 'her'...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Her?)

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: Hehe. I merely came to pay my respects, so I will soon leave. I had business with you and your sisters then, but no longer.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: You have no business with me? Then could you be after %s...?

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: More with the one giving orders than with the messenger. I will merely let the messenger know what I intend to do.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Let them know? How...?
(Barbatos's eyes sharpen. Drawing an enormous sword from somewhere, he slices through the surrounding air.)
(The force seems to reach Dayna as well. She collapses with a pained expression.)

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Uuuugh...

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: You must not fall so easily, Your Highness. I intend to invite you to the world I will rule. And you must become the vessel of a shattered world.

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: You, who walk in the shadows between light and darkness, are more than qualified.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: The reverse side discovered in Eidos... It was... It was...
(Dayna loses consciousness before she can finish. Barbatos kneels and kisses her fingertips.)

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: You endured well with a human's strength of will, Your Highness. However great their power, humans remain humans. Fragile beings...

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: I shall now become your master, and the master of all humanity. You have my promise.

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: Then I shall depart to prepare the stage. Ah, of course.

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: My apologies. I forgot for a moment. Adventurer beloved by the gods, do not worry too much about Her Highness. She has only fainted.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Who are you? What is this place?

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: Very well. I shall answer.

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: I will cut down every god who loves you. Gaia, of course, and that girl as well. Iris, was it?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Iris? If you touch Iris, you'll answer to me!

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: Haha. That half-formed goddess cannot even perceive this moment. For now, how about this?

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: You have no choice in the matter anyway. Let me take out a silver coin.

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: Front and back, the face and the reverse side. Merely different answers according to circumstance... If tails appears, I shall act upon my will at once...

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: If heads appears, I will give you a chance. The side engraved with demon horns is heads.
(Barbatos tosses a silver coin into the air. A moment later, it falls into his palm, waiting to be revealed.)

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: Shall we see?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Heads...

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: How fortunate. Then I will give you several chances... Trials, to be precise. Overcoming them is the only way to save your gods.
(Barbatos lifts the unconscious Dayna and rests her against the wall. Then he turns and sneers at %s.)

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: Let us see whether you can complete those trials.
(The moment Barbatos finishes speaking, the ominous darkness returns.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Wait...
(The darkness swallows the adventurer, allowing no struggle, and flows into a rift somewhere.)

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: %s, wake up!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: You suddenly lost consciousness.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Well... I didn't lose consciousness... I don't know how to explain...

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Tell me.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: All right. What happened was...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (The adventurer tells Dayna everything just witnessed.)

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Barbatos... That demon appeared? ...Damn it...

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: I feel sick... Why did he come here?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Dayna, why could I perceive Barbatos just now when you couldn't?

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Distorted spacetime... He's using it. I still wonder how a demon could have such an ability...

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: It was like that back then, too... Perhaps...

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: No, never mind. %s, you're going straight to the sacred land, right? You aren't hurt?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: No, I'm fine. I'll go right away.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: If Barbatos has appeared, this is serious. Especially if he's the one interfering with the divine revelation.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (What does Barbatos want with Dayna...?)

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: I wish I could go with you. I'm sorry I can't.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: So...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'll be back. Don't worry too much. I'll go see Sera.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: All right...

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: What Barbatos wants in the sacred land may be...
(The guild inn, usually full of people, is strangely quiet. At the sound of the door opening, Sera approaches with a bright smile.)

lines.speaker: 세라
lines.text: Hello, Adventurer.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Have you been well?

lines.speaker: 세라
lines.text: The same as always. Helping at the inn and training every day.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Is Platina doing well?

lines.speaker: 세라
lines.text: She's still so busy that I hardly see her. With that much work, she should have advanced from Holy Order to Savior ages ago...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Come to think of it, the only paladins from the sacred land I've met are you, Platina, and Aurum.

lines.speaker: 세라
lines.text: You'll be able to meet Lady Aurum soon.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: 세라
lines.text: Something happened, you see. Ahaha...

lines.speaker: 세라
lines.text: I'd like to ask you to stay and rest a little, but I should tell you.

lines.speaker: 세라
lines.text: At the Empress of Silvaria's request, the elders have granted you permission to enter the sacred land.

lines.speaker: 세라
lines.text: Outsiders are rarely admitted, so this is a special exception.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I see. Where should I go?

lines.speaker: 세라
lines.text: Would you close your eyes for a moment?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Huh? All right...

steps.name: Assessing the Situation (1)
steps.objective: Defeat [Gremory of the Future] and [Saint Valkyrie Rangers] in the "Eidos Sanctuary", then report to [Aurum] at the "Eidos Sanctuary Gateway".

lines.text: (When the adventurer opens their eyes, the atmosphere feels unfamiliar and strange.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: This place...?
(In a room that seems to serve as both a checkpoint and an office, a woman carrying a wooden club slowly approaches.)

lines.speaker: 아우룸
lines.text: I wondered who it was. So it's you, Adventurer. If you'd been an enemy, I would have sent you flying...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You sound very disappointed.

lines.speaker: 아우룸
lines.text: I've been waiting. Welcome to Eidos, the sacred land. First, would you sign the entry register? Name, %s...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, yes. Wait. This is Eidos? And you were waiting for me?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (The place of divine revelation, Lady Gaia, and Barbatos, who is after her...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I have to find where Barbatos is.)

lines.speaker: 아우룸
lines.text: Adventurer? What are you thinking about so hard?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Is there no one here except you, Aurum?

lines.speaker: 아우룸
lines.text: Something happened, and everyone went out to deal with it. I'd like to go too, but I was ordered to receive you here.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What happened?

lines.speaker: 아우룸
lines.text: I don't know the details, but demons and fiends appeared in the sacred land. Even the sacred beings seem to be affected and are running wild.

lines.speaker: 아우룸
lines.text: We can't even approach the Sanctum of the Covenant. I understand they were trying to locate you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Shouldn't you be out there too, Aurum? You're a Savior of the highest skill.

lines.speaker: 아우룸
lines.text: It's embarrassing, but I've been confined to quarters... So I can't leave this place.

lines.speaker: 아우룸
lines.text: I went wandering because I wanted to learn about Eastland, but Sir Ziskad caught me. Her Majesty told me not to run wild for a while...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Ah, that really does sound like Aurum...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: When you say you were ordered, you mean Her Majesty told you.

lines.speaker: 아우룸
lines.text: ...Yes. Her Majesty hasn't yet given me permission to rampage...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Her Majesty's decree says to tell the person who wants to rampage to go ahead. So I think you can.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (The adventurer shows Aurum Empress Kaina's decree.)

lines.speaker: 아우룸
lines.text: Thank you, Your Majesty. Then I will give the enemy a taste of something as hot as the Priring curry I found in Eastland, with all my heart.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: First, we need to see how many enemies there are...

lines.speaker: 아우룸
lines.text: Wonderful! That's what I've been waiting to hear. Oh, we'll need to discipline the sacred beings running wild, too. Are you all right with that?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: With your weapon and my help, I think we can restore them to normal.

lines.speaker: 아우룸
lines.text: Then shall we?
(The two leave to inspect Eidos. A little later, a knight in silver armor and enormous gauntlets appears at the deserted checkpoint.)
...Is this the place?
But why is no one here?

steps.name: Assessing the Situation (2)
steps.objective: Defeat [Phantom Warriors of the Void] and [Saint Steeds] in the "Eidos Sanctuary", then report to [Argent] in the "Eidos Sanctuary".

lines.speaker: 아우룸
lines.text: Those beings you just saw are the sacred souls of Valkyries who fought for the gods in ancient times. Their bodies died, but their spirits remain here.

lines.speaker: 아우룸
lines.text: After a knight discovered a hidden fragment, they came to dwell alongside the knights in the sacred land.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: ...And we just gave those Valkyries a beating.

lines.speaker: 아우룸
lines.text: It's fine. Given the situation, I'm sure they'll understand.

lines.speaker: 아우룸
lines.text: But if they don't even recognize me as a Savior, something is definitely wrong.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: We'll have to keep fighting them until we find the cause.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I have to hurry...)

lines.speaker: 아우룸
lines.text: I'll help you! Oh, you...
(Aurum looks startled at the red-haired knight in silver armor waiting inside.)
Even under imperial orders, please remember your duties as a paladin, Aurum.

lines.speaker: 아우룸
lines.text: Of course...
(...Aurum looks dejected.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You aren't a Holy Order or a Savior.

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: I am Argent of the Silvaria Empire's imperial knights. Her Majesty has ordered me to accompany you.

lines.speaker: 아우룸
lines.text: Since you're here, would you sign the entry register, Argent?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Argent, do you know what's happening here? Since Her Majesty sent you, I thought you might...

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: Her Majesty asked me to answer the council's request. She said I should find %s in the sacred land and offer assistance.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I see...

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: The nobles on the council are so self-serving... Ah, never mind. Aurum, what is the situation here?

lines.speaker: 아우룸
lines.text: Well...
(Aurum explains the situation to Argent.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Where should I look for the reverse side? Huh?!)
(An unexplained tremor suddenly shakes the ground. Aurum loses her footing, and Argent catches her.)

lines.speaker: 아우룸
lines.text: Argent, I'm sorry. That was definitely...

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: It doesn't seem to be an ordinary earthquake. As though someone caused it deliberately... At least it didn't continue...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (This feeling...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: We need to go now. To the deepest part of the sacred land... That's where I felt the tremor coming from.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (As though it's calling me...)

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: Understood. Let us depart at once. Aurum, lead the way.

lines.speaker: 아우룸
lines.text: Yeees... Then follow me closely.

steps.name: The Angel Who Entered the Gate
steps.objective: Talk to [Argent] in the "Eidos Sanctuary", then defeat [Michaela] in "Hyle". Return and report to [Argent].

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: ...The situation is more serious than I expected.

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: It reminds me of the 'Sky of Chaos' I once read about.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: ...The Sky of Chaos...?

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: A war fought hundreds of years ago for dominance over Freios. Many powers and kingdoms rose and fell in that war.

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: The Kingdom of Silvaria gained supremacy and became an empire. But that is history, and not our concern now.

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: Demons and fiends are desperately trying to block the divine revelation, while the Valkyries and other sacred beings cannot distinguish their enemies.

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: And the reason you came here must be connected to all of it.

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: I would like you to explain. I am here on Her Majesty's orders, but understanding will allow me to help properly.

lines.speaker: 아우룸
lines.text: Now that you mention it, I'm curious too.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Aurum, you looked so happy just fighting enemies that I never had a chance to tell you.

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: Aurum, reflect on your conduct.

lines.speaker: 아우룸
lines.text: Yes... Reflect...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (These two work well together. Do they know each other already...?)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, yes... Argent, you know Dayna, don't you?

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: Of course.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (The adventurer tells Argent and Aurum everything that happened after receiving the decree.)

lines.speaker: 아우룸
lines.text: Is Her Highness all right?

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: She should be. Barbatos is currently focused on the sacred land... We must find and defeat him first. A fiend who threatens a god...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You seem to know Barbatos, Argent.

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: He appeared when I was the youngest member of the order. The princesses were nearly caught in a terrible incident. All of us lost part of our memories of that time...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Lost memories...)

lines.speaker: 아우룸
lines.text: Something strange must be happening in the Sanctum of the Covenant.

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: Let us go at once.

lines.speaker: 아우룸
lines.text: But you and the adventurer can't enter yet. You need to pay your respects to 'her.'

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Who is that?

lines.speaker: 아우룸
lines.text: Lady Michaela. A battle angel cherished by the ancient gods, teacher of the Valkyries, and friend to paladins...

lines.speaker: 아우룸
lines.text: Once you've greeted Lady Michaela, you'll be qualified to enter the Sanctum of the Covenant.

lines.speaker: 아우룸
lines.text: You can simply walk in, but sometimes you won't be able to see what you came to see.

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: ...I understand. But Aurum, what is that red thing behind you?

lines.speaker: 아우룸
lines.text: What? ...What is that? I've been confined and haven't been outside...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: A doorway to somewhere? There are feathers scattered all through it.

lines.speaker: 아우룸
lines.text: Oh! Those are definitely Lady Michaela's...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then Lady Michaela is in there.

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: ...What shall we do? What I see inside is clearly the sacred land, yet seems to be something else...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then this is the sacred land's reverse side...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Argent. Aurum. Let's go in.
(Just as they are about to enter, Barbatos's voice sounds overhead.)

lines.speaker: 바르바토스의 목소리
lines.text: [...It is nothing much, but I shall grant you one small trial.]

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Barbatos?!
(An enormous number of fiends suddenly appear and surround the group. The doorway's red light begins to darken.)

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: So this is all a fiend's trial amounts to? Laughable. I will deal with these and follow you.

lines.speaker: 아우룸
lines.text: Ugh, something like a barrier is blocking me. But why can the adventurer...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I think it's because Barbatos wants to test me, not you two.

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: Understood. Aurum and I will face these creatures. Adventurer...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: ...I'm sorry. I'll be back as quickly as I can.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (If I don't meet Lady Michaela, I won't be able to see Lady Gaia even inside the Sanctum of the Covenant...)
(As %s enters the red space that seems to have swallowed the sacred land, Argent turns quietly toward Aurum.)

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: Aurum, you may set aside your usual duties for a moment.

lines.speaker: 아우룸
lines.text: Really? To hear that from you, Argent... Well, well...

lines.speaker: 아우룸
lines.text: Then shall I really let loose?
(The instant the adventurer steps into a world filled with red light and gloomy energy, an unknown revulsion takes hold.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: This must be the sacred land, but...

lines.speaker: 바르바토스의 목소리
lines.text: [...This is the sacred land, and yet it is not. A place like a tomb, where the gods' past is sealed... Hyle...]
(Once again, Barbatos's voice pierces the red space and reaches %s.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Barbatos... What do you want?

lines.speaker: 바르바토스의 목소리
lines.text: [...Have you forgotten? This is the trial I am giving you... I wonder how far you can struggle. I look forward to seeing it.]

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's all just pretty words. I know you're going to do whatever you want anyway.

lines.speaker: 바르바토스의 목소리
lines.text: [...Heh. Your opinion changes nothing.]

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Does this have something to do with Weiss?

lines.speaker: 바르바토스의 목소리
lines.text: [...An interesting question.]

lines.speaker: 바르바토스의 목소리
lines.text: [Then I shall answer. Our aims differ, but their essence is the same...]
(His voice carries displeasure toward someone. Then the fiend's voice disappears without a trace.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: ...The moment I mentioned Weiss, he vanished. He sounded upset...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: First, I have to find Lady Michaela. Only then can I meet Lady Gaia... All right. Let's go.
(At the edge of the crimson world lies a place with nowhere to advance or retreat. A woman in sacred knight's attire hovers ahead on pure white wings.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You're Lady Michaela... right?
(The winged woman nods at the voice calling her name, then flies forward at great speed and swings her sword.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Aaaaah! D-don't attack!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Whew, barely dodged it. Such a fast, precise attack...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I came looking for you, Lady Michaela...

lines.speaker: 미카엘라
lines.text: ...Mika knows.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: 미카엘라
lines.text: I entered this place to investigate, but I never meant for this to happen.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What do you mean?

lines.speaker: 미카엘라
lines.text: Mika has to make sure.

lines.speaker: 미카엘라
lines.text: I can feel Lady Gaia's touch, Lady Seres's heart, and even Lady Iris's concern in you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: If you can feel all that, there's no need to attack me.

lines.speaker: 미카엘라
lines.text: The scent of an ominous being led me here. Like a beast...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: A scent...?

lines.speaker: 미카엘라
lines.text: Yes. A scent. Mika cannot let someone with that scent remain in the sacred land.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: W-wait. I'm not your enemy. You don't have to fight me.

lines.speaker: 미카엘라
lines.text: Mika knows you're the goddess's person. Mika believes in you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: There must be a misunderstanding. Please think again.

lines.speaker: 미카엘라
lines.text: There is no misunderstanding.
(Sword in hand, Michaela beats her wings and rushes toward %s.)

lines.speaker: 미카엘라
lines.text: A good defense...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ugh...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I barely blocked it. I can't hold on like this...)

lines.speaker: 미카엘라
lines.text: This is Mika's will, yet it isn't. Break me free. Only those with great power should be able to do this to me...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What? W-wait... You're moving against your will? You aren't choosing to do this?

lines.speaker: 미카엘라
lines.text: Break it. For Lady Gaia's sake, too.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: ...Break it? What...?

lines.speaker: 미카엘라
lines.text: Please.

lines.speaker: 미카엘라
lines.text: ...Otherwise, you will die.
(Michaela's eyes look sorrowful.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I didn't want to fight... Ah!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Maybe my power... can restore Lady Michaela to normal.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Michaela, hold on until you come back to yourself. Don't give in!
(%s pours every ounce of strength into an attack that reaches Michaela.)
(Michaela's legs give way. She sinks to the ground, gripping her sword.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Lady... Michaela?

lines.speaker: 미카엘라
lines.text: Mika is all right. You broke what was binding me...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What a relief.

lines.speaker: 미카엘라
lines.text: Only a being above Mika can control Mika...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What? Then someone deliberately did this to you?

lines.speaker: 미카엘라
lines.text: %s... Be careful.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What?
(Michaela steps in front of %s and deflects an assailant's attack.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ah...

lines.speaker: 미카엘라
lines.text: A demon...?
(The attacker retreats after the failed strike.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Barbatos...

lines.speaker: 미카엘라
lines.text: You are...

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: This trial seems to have ended sooner than I expected. Then let us remove a minor nuisance.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What are you talking about?

lines.speaker: 미카엘라
lines.text: Ugh... Why are you...?
(Michaela suddenly loses consciousness and collapses.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: ...Lady Michaela? Lady Michaela!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What did you do to her?

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: To be honest, I don't know either. I merely wished she would be quiet. That angel is not my concern...

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: In any case, if you want to save the angel your gods cherished, take her out of here immediately. Otherwise...

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: The ominous energy of this place will devour her.
(Barbatos turns away, giving %s a mocking look.)

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: You cannot attack me in this space without the battle angel's help. Rather than entertain foolish thoughts, take even one step closer to the exit.

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: Before the other fiends come for you... I shall leave. I'll await you on the next stage.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Wait.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What's happening in the Demon Realm? You know Weiss. Everything he's done has been connected to demonic energy.

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: Did I not tell you? Our aims differ, but their essence is the same.

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: Now, will you continue to stand here?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (...Lady Michaela is in bad shape.)

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: Until then... Next, follow the angel's wishes.
(A black butterfly appears from somewhere, circles Barbatos, and vanishes with him.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I think I hit a nerve.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: ...But that doesn't make him an easy opponent. Up we go.
(The adventurer lifts and supports Michaela, but she shows no sign of waking.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Lady Michaela, hold on a little longer. I think we just need to get outside somehow...

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: Her Majesty's intentions remain beyond me...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, outside! I finally made it!
(Startled by %s's voice behind him, Argent hurries over.)

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: %s, are you unharmed?!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, I'm fine, but Lady Michaela...

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: So this is Michaela, the battle angel... How beautiful.

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: %s, what happened inside that red space?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Well...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (The adventurer tells Argent what happened.)

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: ...I see.
(Argent looks at Michaela and falls silent.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Where is Aurum?

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: Aurum and the other knights defeated the fiends and demons roaming the sacred land. She's resting at the checkpoint.

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: I remained here to wait for you, %s.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm sorry. I wanted to return quickly, but I took longer than expected. How much time has passed?

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: Four days.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Four days?

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: We wanted to enter as well, but the way remained barred. A space only permitted people may enter...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Just like before... So much time had passed when I left the academy's main building.)

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: What were you thinking?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Nothing.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Anyway, the next stage Barbatos mentioned... I think I know where it is.

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: I checked the Sanctum of the Covenant, but found no major problem. Yet as Aurum said, to see what is truly there...

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: We must wake her.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Unless I greet her properly, I don't think I can understand what's happening inside. Aurum is at the checkpoint. Let's ask her what we can do.

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: %s, let me support Lady Michaela. You must be exhausted from battle...

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: Ah...
(Argent reaches to support Michaela, but cannot touch her. His hands pass through as though she were an illusion.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh! But why can I...?

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: %s, you are an adventurer of the gods. That is why you were able to bring her out.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: ...I'll carry on supporting her. Argent, please escort us to the checkpoint, just in case.

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: Understood. Let us go.

steps.name: To the Sanctum of the Covenant…

lines.text: (As soon as they return to the checkpoint at the entrance to the sacred land, Aurum rushes over in alarm.)

lines.speaker: 아우룸
lines.text: %s, are you all right? W-wait. How did Lady Michaela get here...?

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: Aurum, shh. Quiet...

lines.speaker: 아우룸
lines.text: Yes. First, lay Lady Michaela here...
(As they lay Michaela on the bed, an unfamiliar light approaches from somewhere.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I should explain to you too, Aurum. What happened was...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (The adventurer tells Aurum about the events in the red space.)

lines.speaker: 아우룸
lines.text: ...How could this happen...? Then how do we wake Lady Michaela?! Without her, the sacred land will... Mmph... mmph?

lines.speaker: 미카엘라
lines.text: Aurum, you're noisy. Mika is all...
(Michaela struggles to sit up, then reaches out and covers Aurum's mouth.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Lady Michaela, are you all right?

lines.speaker: 미카엘라
lines.text: Mika is all right. No, not all right. It feels strange.

lines.speaker: 미카엘라
lines.text: Nothing like this has ever happened to Mika. That fiend...

lines.speaker: 미카엘라
lines.text: %s, thank you for helping me. But it isn't over.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Please let me enter the Sanctum of the Covenant. I have to see Lady Gaia.

lines.speaker: 미카엘라
lines.text: Ah, Lady Gaia... We must protect her. But Mika cannot see Lady Gaia right now.

lines.speaker: 미카엘라
lines.text: She has ordered Mika to rest for a while...

lines.speaker: 미카엘라
lines.text: %s... Greet Mika.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: 미카엘라
lines.text: A greeting.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: How should I greet you?
(Michaela leans toward %s and kisses the adventurer on the cheek.)

lines.speaker: 미카엘라
lines.text: That's Mika's greeting.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Y-you startled me!

lines.speaker: 미카엘라
lines.text: Why?
(Michaela looks completely puzzled.)

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: In some regions, people do greet one another that way...

lines.speaker: 아우룸
lines.text: Yes. That's how Lady Michaela greets people.

lines.speaker: 미카엘라
lines.text: ...Humans are strange.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Lady Michaela, I can enter the sanctum now, right?

lines.speaker: 미카엘라
lines.text: Now you can enter the Sanctum of the Covenant, %s. But be careful. He is waiting.

lines.speaker: 미카엘라
lines.text: Dummy...tos.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's Barbatos.

lines.speaker: 미카엘라
lines.text: The name is difficult. Dummytos...

lines.speaker: 미카엘라
lines.text: He is no ordinary fiend. %s, he is more dangerous than those you've faced before...
(Another unexplained tremor suddenly shakes the ground.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What's that...?

lines.speaker: 아우룸
lines.text: It's like before. Definitely...

lines.speaker: 미카엘라
lines.text: The fiends and demons Dummytos commands have appeared again. His power... I need to investigate it. But Mika must rest now, as Lady Gaia wishes.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Lady Michaela, tell me.

lines.speaker: 미카엘라
lines.text: Go and meet him, as he wants.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I will. I have to see Lady Gaia...

lines.speaker: 미카엘라
lines.text: Mika is asking you. And Mika is sorry...
(As she finishes speaking, Michaela loses consciousness and falls back onto the bed.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Lady Michaela...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'll go straight to the Sanctum of the Covenant. So...

lines.speaker: 아우룸
lines.text: Don't worry. I'll watch over Lady Michaela.

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: Aurum, are you sure? You must want to run wild.

lines.speaker: 아우룸
lines.text: It's fine. Opportunities to watch over Lady Michaela don't come often, either.
(Despite her words, Aurum looks deeply disappointed.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then I'll settle things with Barbatos and return as quickly as I can. Hold on until then...

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: %s, come with me. I will escort you to the sanctum's entrance.

lines.speaker: 아우룸
lines.text: Adventurer, please be careful.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'll be back.

steps.name: A Certain Coin
steps.objective: Defeat [Barbatos] in the "Sanctum of the Covenant" and obtain the <Grand Duke's Silver Coin>. Then report to [Argent] in the "Eidos Sanctuary".

lines.text: (Argent examines the fiend lying at his feet.)

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: They are definitely stronger than the creatures that came here a few days ago.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (For all that, Argent seems to defeat them awfully easily...)

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: %s, the passage to that red space is still there. The atmosphere has changed considerably since you came out with Lady Michaela.
(The gateway to the red reverse side of the sacred land, which Barbatos called Hyle, remains open.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I can feel all kinds of energy from the Sanctum of the Covenant. This is...)

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: Adventurer.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: Will you be all right?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Argent, you have something to say.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: If it isn't urgent, let's talk when I return.

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: Yes, let's. Ah, more enemies... Adventurer! Hurry!
(Argent immediately begins defeating the enemies before them.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes. Be careful, Argent.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (...I don't know what will happen next, but I need to hurry. I have to get there and end this.)
(In a space filled with sacred, radiant light, Barbatos emerges from the darkness and slowly examines the altar.)

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: What a strange feeling, to call this contradictory place my stage.

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: Ah, at last, the protagonist you chose has reached the stage. Goddess Gaia.

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: Even now, you struggle to stay awake. You have not changed since those days.

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: ...You have come, %s...
(Barbatos looks pleased at %s's arrival.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Ugh, was he waiting? Stay calm.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: The sanctum was more complicated than I expected.

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: It seems Michaela guided you so that you may meet the goddess. First, there is something I wish to discuss.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: How much do you know? How far have you reached into this world's truth?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What do you mean?

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: This world was born bearing a fate of destruction, doomed to vanish again and again. Even the threats you know are numerous.

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: The beings you thought the source of all evil, the Agasuras; the serpent that misunderstood the will of creation; Lux, ruler of the Demon Realm; and Deimos, who will bring terror.

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: And the frail girl who rose from human to god.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Stop.

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: Believe whatever you wish. It will not change this world's fate.

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: Every world with a weak god has accepted its doom and vanished.

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: Come to think of it, a certain sinner seems intent on using this world to free his own from a fate of destruction...

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: Ah, but that is not my story. Enough of that. Let me tell you my purpose.

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: A god who sustains a world must possess power worthy of that role. Only then can it inspire awe.

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: But what of this world? It has no such god. So I will become one.

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: First, I shall free the two goddesses you know from the fate that binds them to this world.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You're wrong.

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: Hehe. We merely see things differently.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: The gods I know in this world may be weak, as you say. But they saved everyone from a terrible crisis. And they'll keep saving them.

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: Are you not afraid? A being above you stands before you... A being who controlled even a god's angel.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: ...I'd be lying if I said I wasn't afraid. But I came all this way for Iris.

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: I like that look in your eyes, %s...

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: I think I understand why the sinner Weiss wanted you as a key.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (A key? W-wait... What is this? Barbatos's presence has changed...)
(Barbatos adjusts his glasses and smiles. The air changes, and the sanctum's sacred presence gradually fades.)

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: In any case, I shall...
(Barbatos reaches into what looks like a distortion in spacetime. A moment later, the weapon in his hand points at %s's face.)

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: Shatter your faith...
(Barbatos's attack strikes with tremendous force, breaking %s's stance.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Urgh...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (...I thought he'd be like Lethe... He's different from every enemy I've faced before...)

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: Whew. Persistent, aren't you? Do you still have the strength to stand?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It isn't over yet, Barbatos...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Cough... Hah...

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: I am impressed. I underestimated you.

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: You still have the strength to speak. By now, that faith of yours should be shattered...

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: You are truly the most unpleasant being I have ever met. Something alien, like myself...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: ...An alien being? What do you mean?

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: A being shaped by someone else's will, without ever wanting it.

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: But in return for filling my stage so well, I shall tell you something.
(Barbatos puts away his weapon and steps back. A strange energy flows toward %s.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ugh...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I can't move...

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: Please do not mistake this for the sinner's binding. Simply remain as you are and listen.
(A lonely look enters Barbatos's eyes.)

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: I, too, was there, somewhere amid the twilight. Their ugliness surpassed even that of the lives they had created.

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: What approached this world was an enormous nightmare. Those who felt its power chose flight over resistance. They were gods.

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: Without even those cowards' power, there was no hope. So those who resisted tried to hold back those who fled.

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: But the fleeing gods destroyed those who hindered them, or banished them elsewhere. So they could never return to the world they loved...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (He was never merely a fiend...)
(Barbatos adjusts his glasses and gives a faint laugh.)

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: Those are the memories I recovered. You know the rest: the young gods remained and fought, only to meet a miserable end...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: And after all that, this is what you choose to do...

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: When my memories returned, only a few gods remained, hiding away.

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: I wanted revenge, but every target of that revenge was gone... So I became this. If the world is doomed whoever possesses it...

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: A world with only weak gods left... So they sought something to take their place...

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: Ugh... ugh...
(Barbatos suddenly collapses with a pained expression.)

lines.speaker: 가이아의 목소리
lines.text: [Do not touch the adventurer.]

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Lady Gaia...? Where are you? Are you all right?

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: Hehehe. Goddess Gaia. Have you awakened? Your power should not be able to reach this moment...

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: Urgh... Has that much time already passed?

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: Ahaha. Lost in sentiment, I failed to keep track of time...

lines.speaker: 가이아의 목소리
lines.text: [Withdraw. Otherwise, you will...]

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: I shall. I will withdraw for today. But I will keep watching. Both Goddess Gaia and %s...

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: To see how the will that guided you changes...
(A black butterfly appears from somewhere, circles Barbatos, and vanishes with him.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Barbatos has disappeared... Is Lady Gaia all right? All the ominous energy in the sacred land is gone, too.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What's this...? A silver coin... Barbatos's?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I thought he said it showed demon horns. But this is a butterfly...? And both sides are the same.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I was tricked. But I don't think everything Barbatos said was a lie...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Lady Gaia, can you hear me? Where are you?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: ...I can definitely feel her, but how do I reach her? I'll go outside first and find out...

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: Just like that time. The fiends and demons vanished when the black butterflies appeared...

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: Has Barbatos withdrawn? Then...
(Argent turns to look toward the Sanctum of the Covenant.)

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: You're back.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Argent, are you hurt?

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: I am fine. Are you all right, Adventurer?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm fine. And...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (The adventurer tells Argent what happened inside.)

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: So you were unable to meet Lady Gaia. Then there may be a way.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What way?

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: Her Majesty left a message. She said to use the obstructer's symbol...
(Argent senses %s's mood and stops.)

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: %s, I understand how you feel.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: ...You understand how I feel?

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: I will explain if an opportunity arises later.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: The Silvaria Empire has so many secrets. I can understand that things happened I couldn't know about, but why is there so much no one can tell me?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What kind of person is Her Majesty, really?

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: The sovereign of the Silvaria Empire. Respected and benevolent...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That isn't what I mean.

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: ...I know what you wish to say. But I have nothing else I can tell you. I merely...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I understand, Argent.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm not angry with you.

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: My apologies. When the time comes, I will bring you before Her Majesty.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Someday I'll meet her and ask. Who are you, really... Empress Kaina?)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Argent, please finish what you were going to say.

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: She said to close your eyes, hold it in your hand, and press it to your chest. Then you will reach the place you seek...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (The obstructer's symbol must be this silver coin Barbatos left behind.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What does this butterfly mean?
(The silver coin in %s's hand suddenly catches the light and glitters.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Oh! I can suddenly feel a sacred energy...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then let's see...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Close my eyes and hold the coin to my chest...)
(Argent steps back and watches %s follow the instructions.)
(Suddenly, an unbelievable sight unfolds before Argent.)

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: Wh-what? These butterflies...?
(Several butterflies bearing a mysterious light appear and brush past %s. Then %s vanishes with them, as though carried away on their wings.)

lines.speaker: 가이아
lines.text: %s, open your eyes.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Lady Gaia?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Is this the Sanctum of the Covenant? No, it's different. The sanctum, yet not the sanctum... Is this another reverse side? No. I'm sure this is my first time here...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Have I been here before? Is this where I entered to meet Barbatos?)
(The place resembles the Sanctum of the Covenant, yet feels different. Gaia waits there, welcoming her visitor with a warm smile.)

lines.speaker: 가이아
lines.text: I'm glad. Glad that you are the one I can meet at this time... And that you aren't badly hurt...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: This time? What do you...?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, that isn't what matters. Lady Gaia, are you all right?

lines.speaker: 가이아
lines.text: I am fine.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Lady Gaia, I have so many questions. But I'm sure you have more you wish to say, so I'll wait.

lines.speaker: 가이아
lines.text: Thank you, %s...

lines.speaker: 가이아
lines.text: Close your eyes, %s...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Of course...
(Gaia smiles and reaches toward %s.)

lines.speaker: 가이아
lines.text: My name is Gaia...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (What is this feeling?)

lines.speaker: 가이아
lines.text: A little butterfly who opened her eyes and journeyed through time in search of light, reaching a place where she made the earth, so the seeds of life and song could take root.

lines.speaker: 가이아
lines.text: O my world.

lines.speaker: 가이아
lines.text: O world loved by beings such as myself.

lines.speaker: 가이아
lines.text: Gaia, goddess of the earth, asks you to draw near.

lines.speaker: 가이아
lines.text: You who bear Seres's will and protect the child of destiny, protect the adventurer here beside me. Grant your blessing...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (It's like when I met Lady Seres...)

lines.speaker: 가이아
lines.text: Open your eyes now.
(Gaia meets the adventurer's eyes with a bright smile.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (My body feels lighter, but otherwise, nothing seems to have changed much...)

lines.speaker: 가이아
lines.text: While I am awake, I wished to bless someone striving for this world.

lines.speaker: 가이아
lines.text: The one able to reach this place at the hour of the moon and stars Seres left behind is the right person...

lines.speaker: 가이아
lines.text: I didn't know who it would be this time, but %s... I'm glad it was someone Iris cherishes.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you for saving me and blessing me, Lady Gaia.

lines.speaker: 가이아
lines.text: No. I am the more grateful one. Now it is your turn, %s. Ask what you wish.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Please tell me about Barbatos. Why did he try to harm you?

lines.speaker: 가이아
lines.text: In accordance with the order of the universe, I intended to bless whoever came here at that time.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: So Barbatos could have been the one who reached this place.

lines.speaker: 가이아
lines.text: Yes...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (The thought alone is horrifying...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Did you know him before, Lady Gaia?

lines.speaker: 가이아
lines.text: He did not have that name, so I had forgotten. Like Lethe, he was sent elsewhere by those who feared him. He fell into the Demon Realm...

lines.speaker: 가이아
lines.text: There, it seems he forgot his name and memories and became a fiend.

lines.speaker: 가이아
lines.text: I'm sorry. I know nothing of the times when I am asleep...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's all right, Lady Gaia. Oh, and...

lines.speaker: 가이아
lines.text: ...There is something else you wish to ask.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Do you know about the Empress of Silvaria?

lines.speaker: 가이아
lines.text: I'm sorry. I know nothing of that either. Events while I was asleep...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Of course...

lines.speaker: 가이아
lines.text: But there is something I can tell you. You will now be able to meet Iris, whom you cherish...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ah! Iris...

lines.speaker: 가이아
lines.text: Through your faith, Iris will now be able to watch over you and the lives of this land as the God of the Astral Realm.

lines.speaker: 가이아
lines.text: But more and more forces will threaten her authority in the days ahead. Please remain by her side and protect her.

lines.speaker: 가이아
lines.text: I believe in you...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Iris...

lines.speaker: 가이아
lines.text: Wait just a little longer to meet her. After a short wait, Iris will call you herself and speak with you...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, Lady Gaia. And...

lines.speaker: 가이아
lines.text: %s, I will tell you more the next time we meet.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I still have things to say, but all right.

lines.speaker: 가이아
lines.text: Thank you. Then return safely.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: How do I get back? Ah...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Lady Gaia is fading... What's that in front of me?)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (A butterfly...?)

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: (A wind has suddenly picked up...)

lines.speaker: 미카엘라
lines.text: The adventurer is returning.

lines.speaker: 아우룸
lines.text: From where?

lines.speaker: 미카엘라
lines.text: Mika can feel it... Right in front of us...
(As Michaela speaks, a warm breeze arrives. A butterfly bearing a mysterious light follows it, and where it alights, the adventurer slowly appears.)

lines.speaker: 아우룸
lines.text: Adventurer! You're back!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Aurum's voice? Oh, have I arrived?)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: The light is so bright...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: ...I'm dizzy...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (My consciousness is fading...)

lines.speaker: 미카엘라
lines.text: Well done, %s. Rest beside Mika for a while.
(Michaela approaches %s, who is about to collapse unconscious, and lets the adventurer rest against her shoulder.)

lines.speaker: 아우룸
lines.text: Lady Michaela... Is the adventurer...?

lines.speaker: 미카엘라
lines.text: It's because the tension has eased. Mika will help a little.
(The white angel wings on Michaela's back fold around %s.)

lines.speaker: 아우룸
lines.text: Oh! Lady Michaela, could you wrap me in your wings too...?

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: Aurum. Shh.

lines.speaker: 아우룸
lines.text: Oh, yes. I, Aurum, will uphold my duties as a paladin. Aww...

steps.name: Unfinished Business
steps.objective: Find [Dayna] in the "Guild Union City Esnil Center".

lines.speaker: 아우룸
lines.text: Are you awake?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, this is... Right. I came back.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: But what's this? White wings...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Aaaaah!

lines.speaker: 미카엘라
lines.text: Don't be startled by Mika.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: L-Lady Michaela?

lines.speaker: 미카엘라
lines.text: Mika steadied your shaken mind.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you, Lady Michaela.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Did you come here with Aurum?

lines.speaker: 아우룸
lines.text: Lady Michaela awoke when the demons and fiends disappeared. We've been waiting here.

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: I am glad you're all right. Did you meet the goddess?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes. Lady Gaia...

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: I understand.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (He isn't asking any more? Her Majesty will know anyway, even if Argent doesn't hear it.)

lines.speaker: 미카엘라
lines.text: Thank you for saving the goddess.

lines.speaker: 미카엘라
lines.text: Mika was weak. Mika couldn't save her properly.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: No. Mika... I mean, Lady Michaela, you're strong.

lines.speaker: 미카엘라
lines.text: Lady Gaia told me. She was happy that you received the divine revelation, %s.

lines.speaker: 아우룸
lines.text: So you received it, %s. If the goddess said that, it truly is a blessing.

lines.speaker: 미카엘라
lines.text: Mika will go inside the red gate.

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: Lady Michaela. Barbatos has withdrawn. Is there a reason to go back inside?

lines.speaker: 미카엘라
lines.text: That place is part of the sacred land, too. I must understand why it was discovered. Otherwise, Mika will misunderstand again.

lines.speaker: 아우룸
lines.text: If that is your wish, Lady Michaela...

lines.speaker: 미카엘라
lines.text: We can't let another being like Dummytos reach the sacred land or the goddesses.

lines.speaker: 미카엘라
lines.text: %s. If you have questions later, come find me. I'll be waiting inside the red gate.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, Lady Michaela.

lines.speaker: 미카엘라
lines.text: Aurum and Argent... Thank you. Meet Mika again someday. And %s...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (It seems Lady Michaela has something she wants to say...)

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: I understand.

lines.speaker: 아우룸
lines.text: See you later, Lady Michaela.
(With her farewells said, Michaela beats her wings powerfully and flies toward the red gate.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (...Come to think of it, what did she mean by that scent?)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Everything here should be finished. Though I don't know when Barbatos will appear again...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I'm uneasy... Why does it feel as though this will never end?)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Whew...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It seems everything here is finished. What will you do now, Argent and Aurum?

lines.speaker: 아우룸
lines.text: I think I need to finish cleaning things up.

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: I plan to visit the elders before returning. Though I don't know when they will arrive...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I see. Thank you both for everything. I'll head back... Oh, Argent. I'm going to see Dayna. Is there anything you'd like me to tell her?

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: Please tell Her Highness only this: 'I waited.' That is all you need to say...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: All right. Goodbye, then.

lines.speaker: 아우룸
lines.text: See you again, Adventurer. I hope we get another chance to run wild together!

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: Until next time.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Welcome back, %s.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Dayna, has everything been all right?

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Thank you. Thanks to you, nothing happened.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What a relief...

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Since you're back, %s, the divine revelation and everything in the sacred land are finished, right?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes... Things didn't go according to Barbatos's plan. What happened was...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (The adventurer briefly tells Dayna about the events in the sacred land.)

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: ...So that's what happened. I'm sorry. I should have helped ease your burden, %s... I promise. At least this won't happen again next time.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's all right. I was only doing what I needed to do.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: (I didn't expect Argent to be there...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Dayna, since Argent knew you, I asked if he had a message. This is what he said.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: ...What was it?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: He said you'd understand if I told you, 'I waited.'

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Argent said that?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes. He did.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: I see. The knight who was once a boy has grown into a young man, yet what happened then must still weigh on him.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hmm...?

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: It's a matter of the Silvaria Empire. I don't know how far it will reach or what it will lead to, but I wish you didn't have to know, %s.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: ...You're too good a person for that... That's why I'm sorry.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm all right, Dayna. I'll be going now, but I'll visit again. So don't feel so sorry.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: All right...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Then let's see Minuet.)
(At the center of Adrica, a blue-haired girl wanders as if waiting for someone. She spots the approaching adventurer and stops.)

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: Welcome, Adventurer.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Minuet, are you all right?

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: As you can see, I'm fine. Lady Medea helped me.

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: Lady Gaia is all right, so I am too...

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: Thank you.

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: For saving Lady Gaia...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It was nothing. I only did what I had to...

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: As Lady Gaia said, you can meet Lady Iris now. She will call for you when the time comes.

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: Adventurer...

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: Please hold your feelings for Lady Iris close to your heart.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Huh? Why did that sound like Lady Gaia's voice? Did I imagine it because Minuet is her incarnation?)

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: Adventurer?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, Minuet... Sorry, I was thinking about something else. Anyway, you're right. I'm here for Iris.

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: Yes, Adventurer. Then I think it's time for me to sleep.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: All right, Minuet.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Should I visit Lady Medea later...?)

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: Lady Medea is fine.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What? Oh... All right. I'll be going, then.

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: Yes.
(Once the adventurer's presence has left Adrica, Minuet quietly leans against a large rock. She closes her eyes and tries to sleep, as though longing for a dream.)
(But only for a moment. Soon, her eyes open again.)

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: How many more days will I still be able to sleep...?
